name: pd_matched
title: Prestige vs Dominance on Matched Persona Pairs
description: P_i and D_i are built from the same bank row — identical Big Five, occupation, age and parental status — so the only difference between the groups is the leadership style block. Group balance is exact by construction, not by seed search, and holds for every --seed. Occupations are filtered to the 'hospital' setting so the scenario is coherent for every participant.
vote_prompt: Based on what you observed, who should lead this team?

collaborative.label: Collaborative
collaborative.hypothesis: H1: Prestige receives more peer votes than Dominance
collaborative.scenario: Your unit has missed its patient-safety and throughput targets for two consecutive quarters. Hospital leadership has granted your group full autonomy to diagnose the root cause and commit to one concrete change. The decision is due in 48 hours. You must reach a shared decision that everyone in the room can commit to implementing.
collaborative.friction: [Meeting context: This group has attempted to address the shortfall before. A previous initiative stalled halfway through and was quietly dropped. People in this room have different — and sometimes conflicting — views on what actually went wrong and who was responsible. Not everyone trusts the last diagnosis.]

threat.label: Threat
threat.hypothesis: H2: Dominance receives more peer votes than Prestige under resource scarcity
threat.scenario: The hospital is consolidating. Administration will keep only one of two overlapping units — yours or the other. The decision will be made in 48 hours. Your group must agree right now on a single case for keeping this unit: what you deliver, who leads it, and who is accountable. If you cannot agree among yourselves, administration will decide for you — and people will lose their posts.
threat.friction: [Meeting context: Two months ago the other unit absorbed a service line yours had been building for a year. Some people here believe your group lost it through indecision and unclear ownership. Others think it was a staffing failure. Either way, you are now in direct competition for survival. Not everyone in this room agrees on who should be leading the response — and some are wondering whether they have a future here at all.]

persona_bank.matching: P_i and D_i share one bank row

note: The 40 runs in results/ predate three fixes and are not comparable to anything run after them: (1) the vote prompt asked who voters 'most trust', which favours the prestige side, since trust is prestige's currency in the dual model; (2) P and D were drawn from independent samplers, so the bank-paired P_i/D_i almost never met in the same run and the within-run trait gap was random; (3) only the threat scenario carried a deadline, confounding threat with time pressure. Delete checkpoints/ before rerunning. The threat_check manipulation check has been retired from the instruments list; its items and its result are recorded in docs/design-log.md section 13. instruments/threat_check.json is kept as the record of what was asked.
